The '''capture of the ''Omicron 1''''' took place during the [[Operation Skyhook]].

==Background==
In order to learn more about the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] managed to sabotage and disable a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]], ''[[Omicron 1]]'', that was carrying [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officers assigned to the Death Star.<ref name="Xwing" /><ref name="XWOSG" />

The Alliance sent the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Hunter (Lambda-class)|''Hunter'']], along with the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Inad (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Inad'']], to capture the disabled transport. The operation was protected by [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]].<ref name="XWOSG" />

==The battle==
[[File:HunterShuttle.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Hunter (Lambda-class)|''Hunter'']] boards an Imperial transport.]]

Soon after the mission began, several [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] arrived. The Rebel fighters moved to intercept at the cost of three X-wings. The ''Hunter'' boarded the transport and captured the officers. However while both vessels were returning to the ''Inad'', the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'' arrived and began to launch three [[TIE series/Legends|TIEs]]. An Imperial transport also jumped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and attempted to recapture the fleeing transport. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] destroyed the attacking transport, and two more which arrived shortly afterward. However, both his wingmen were shot down while attempting to keep the Imperial fighters off his tail. [[Namrhe]] was killed but [[Omin-Oreh]] was rescued but severely injured.<ref name="XWOSG" />

==Aftermath==
As soon as both ships had boarded the ''Inad'', the Rebels withdrew to hyperspace. The captured military advisors were unable to reveal much information except that [[Bevel Lemelisk]] was leading the design team and that some of his team had recently traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for a meeting with [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. The Alliance planned an [[Capture of the Death Star design team|assault]] on [[Godar|their ship]].
